controller.description: Memoryless law evaluated before each integration step; events use [start,end).
equations: support x=0,v=0 until event onset; +a for 0.1s then -a for 0.1s, then stationary; continuous analytic position and velocity.
theta_ddot=-(g*sin(theta)+support_acceleration*cos(theta))/length; positive theta displaces load toward +x; motion imposed at integration substeps.
